observations: Photo 0: A torque converter seated inside a transmission bellhousing, wiring harness and sensor connectors draped across it, resting on bare dirt ground, a vehicle wheel and dark vehicle body visible in background.

Photo 1: Side view of a transmission case/bellhousing, metal casing with worn paint, red marker marks on the housing, a small sticker/label present but text unreadable, dirt ground beneath, a drink can visible in background.

Photo 2: Transmission bellhousing separated from its torque converter, showing internal splines and gasket mating surface, torque converter lying beside it with visible wear marks and a chalk circle marking.
Watermark 'FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL' appears across all three photos, identifying the seller's business, not the part's brand.
